integrity: The proof reduces the derivation coefficient equations to two functional equations on the prime field, diagonalizes them in a Vandermonde basis on the multiplicative group, and counts the surviving exponents using the multiplicative order of 2. A standalone checker verifies explicit basis maps and independent small-prime nullities.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats odd prime quandle order equal to the coefficient characteristic.
Composite dihedral-quandle orders and cross-characteristic cases are not classified.
An equivalent modular calculation may exist under different terminology.
title: Prime dihedral quandle algebras have arithmetic modular derivations
